pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions exhibiting jagged, stellate edge contours with sharp pixel gradients. The patches vary in spatial area, becoming progressively smaller and more densely clustered towards the posterior and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a complex topological graph. Multiple tri-junction and quad-junction nodes are visible where pathways intersect. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains narrow and relatively uniform throughout the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck line, representing the mane structure against the background.
